overlay.helper_other: {{count}} clips have a clean copy. Redraw puts the current caption card, kill feed and names on them again, then makes the reels again. No CS2 needed.

add.revoked: Revoked. A recorder with that key gets no more work.
add.title: Add a recorder
add.needs: Run this on a Linux PC with Docker, Steam (signed in) and CS2 installed, from its desktop session. The recorder uses its GPU and finds CS2 in its Steam libraries.
add.name: Name for this PC
add.once: This key is shown once. Copy the command now; to add another PC, make a new one.
add.after: Paste it in a terminal on the PC. It starts now and again whenever Docker does.
add.copyFailed: Could not copy: select the command and copy it
add.pcNeeds: A Linux PC with Docker, Steam (signed in) and CS2 installed. Paste this in a terminal in its desktop session. The recorder uses its GPU and finds CS2 in its Steam libraries. Don't game or run other GPU work on it while it records: the clips would stutter.
add.serverNeeds: An Ubuntu 24.04 server with an NVIDIA GPU, no desktop needed. The first line (once, with sudo) installs the NVIDIA driver and Docker and turns sleep off; reboot if it says so. The second starts Steam and CS2 in a container and the recorder in it.
add.pcAfter: It starts now and again whenever Docker does.
add.serverAfter: Then, once: open the web UI it prints (port 8483), sign Steam in, set it to offline mode and install CS2. The recorder starts taking work when CS2 is there. Run the second line again to update it.
add.baseNameHelp: Recorder, die sich mit diesem Befehl verbinden, heißen {{name}}-1, {{name}}-2, … Umbenennen kannst du sie in der Liste.
